description: Two in-order ARQ C_PDUs to one peer, the later of higher priority, get FSNs in submission order.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with in-order delivery, the default order (service type octets 10 00), and at 0 sends "ping" at priority 0 to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3; the link is made as cas/make-caller-accepted, on PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED at 91000, and the SIS passes "ping" down (A-0194), an ARQ C_PDU with DELIVER IN ORDER (A-0077). The peer's burst ends at 92000, csma.vdcd_end to 96000. At 93000 the client sends "pong" at priority 12, also in order (octet c9: priority 12, SAP 9). It is passed down at once, the soft link being open. Priority alone would place "pong" first (C-0851), but in order means in the order submitted (C-0017, A-0077), at DTS level (C-0018), and C-0851 gives way to it: "ping" is ordered with the priority of the later in-order C_PDU to the same peer (C-1253), so at 108000, after LBT rule 1 and a 12000 ms contention wait, one transmission carries DATA-ONLY FSN 0 with "ping" (TX WIN LWE set) then FSN 1 with "pong" (TX WIN UWE set), each one segment with DELIVER IN ORDER, in consecutive FSNs (C-0850). Two DATA-ONLY D_PDUs of 29 bytes take three blocks (75 bytes), so one PADDING of 11 bytes goes in the 17 spare bytes (C-1154, the peer recorded Ed4); EOTs 30, 20 and 10. When the transmission ends at 123150 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with the derived answer wait, 205500 ms (C-1120). dts.ttd runs to the TTD of the queued C_PDUs (C-1050). Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
